      <img class="c-founder-img" src="/img/founder/jubayer.jpg"
           alt="Md. Jubayer Hossain" width="864" height="1084">
      <div class="c-founder-body">
        <p class="c-founder-name">Md. Jubayer Hossain</p>
        <p class="c-founder-role">Founder &amp; Executive Director</p>
        <p>
          He founded CHIRAL Bangladesh in 2020 to close a specific gap:
          undergraduates here reach graduation without ever having designed a
          study, cleaned a dataset, or read a reviewer's report on their own
          work.
        </p>
        <p>
          The centre exists to put them on real projects with real supervision
          and keep them there until something is published — free to join,
          volunteer-run, with students first-authoring their own work and the
          teaching material kept open so the capacity stays in the region.
        </p>
        <ul class="c-person-social c-founder-social">
          <li><a aria-label="Md. Jubayer Hossain on LinkedIn"><i class="bi bi-linkedin"></i></a></li>

        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
